theme_short: New powers for you and your AI
theme: **New powers for you and your AI.** Four picks put everyday tools in your hands - a TV declutterer, a 3D designer, a phone gaming deck, and a Mac-to-iPad link. The other six sharpen the AI agents that work for you.
method: **How this week was picked:** 273 candidates from 6 of 6 sources (GitHub Trending, Trendshift, skills.sh, findarepo, Hacker News, YouTube pre-scan Oct 17). GitHub search found candidates only (not an independent source). 13 cleared all floors. Picks: 4 by score, 3 new this week (under 45 days), 1 still climbing (over 90 days), 2 additional by score after slot allocation. **Every repo passed our safety check on Oct 23.** php/php-src (3 open advisories) failed the gate and was replaced by Graphify-Labs/graphify. Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model excluded: star-gated access (must star to unlock features) inflates the star count, and its platform deepseek-harness is blocklisted for 5 CVEs. deepseek-ai/DeepInfer (REVIEW, activity flag: 20.6K stars on 4 commits) could not be settled (command blocked) - does not appear. 3 repos taken down this week: DuarteSantos8/openGym (8 new advisories, was Edition 012 pick), akitaonrails/ai-memory (new advisory), garrytan/gstack (new advisory, REVIEW - not blocklisted, needs JJ). Tips: none this week (data/tips.md empty).

picks.name: CleanYourTV
picks.oneliner: One app that strips the ads and bloat off your smart TV and replaces the launcher with a clean one.

picks.name: SolidCraft
picks.oneliner: Free, open-source 3D design software you can run in your browser or on your desktop - or let your AI agent drive it.

picks.name: DroidDeck
picks.oneliner: Turns an Android phone or handheld into a Steam Deck - play your PC games on the go.

picks.name: Claude Plugins Official
picks.oneliner: Anthropic's curated directory of plugins for Claude Code - browse, install, and extend what your AI can do.

picks.name: Agent Skills
picks.oneliner: A pack of ready-made skill files that teach your AI coding agent to plan, build, test and ship like a senior engineer.

picks.name: Ghidra
picks.oneliner: The NSA's free tool for taking software apart - used by security researchers to find what code really does.

picks.name: Hindsight
picks.oneliner: Long-term memory for AI agents - they remember what worked before and get better over time.

picks.name: FreeLLMApi
picks.oneliner: One app that connects you to every major AI model's free tier - no API keys, automatic failover.

picks.name: Sill
picks.oneliner: Streams any Mac window to your iPhone or iPad with full touch and Pencil control - no account needed.

picks.name: Graphify
picks.oneliner: Turns your codebase into a searchable map your AI agent can query - finds anything in seconds.
